title: The Blessings of Pure Hands
logline: A daughter who once washed her father's feet carries his spoken blessing through his death and into her adult life.

shots.reason: Opens on the ritual itself, hands and water only: the act of service that earns the blessing, before we see any face.
shots.keyframe_prompt: insert shot from above: small hands hold a clay pitcher and pour a thin stream of warm water into a wide metal basin on a woven straw mat, a white cotton dress hem with a green-yellow-red tibeb border at the edge of frame, oil lamp glow, steam rising
shots.motion_prompt: slow gentle push-in as water pours softly into the basin
shots.narration_am: በልጅነቴ የአባቴን እግር ሳጥብ፣ ልቤ በብዙ ምርቃት ይሞላ ነበር።
shots.narration_en: As a child, washing my father's feet, my heart would fill with so many blessings.

shots.reason: Puts father and daughter in one frame so the audience sees who blesses whom; the hand on the head is the film's motif.
shots.keyframe_prompt: medium shot: the father sits on a low wooden chair with his feet in a metal basin of water; the girl kneels on the mat beside the basin and looks up at him; he rests one gentle hand on top of her head in blessing, warm pure smile
shots.motion_prompt: subtle slow pull-back with soft lamp glow
shots.narration_am: ‘እግዚአብሔር ይባርክሽ፤ በመንገድሽ እግዜብሄር ይቅደምልሽ፣ በጥበብ እና በማስተዋል ያሳድግሽ’ ይለኝ ነበር።
shots.narration_en: 'May God bless you, may He go before you on your path, may He raise you in wisdom and understanding,' he would say.

shots.reason: The close-up on the child's face is where the words land; it is the seed the rest of the film grows from.
shots.keyframe_prompt: close-up portrait of the girl's face looking up with trust and reverence, listening, warm golden rim light, soft lamp-lit room behind her
shots.motion_prompt: very slow push toward her eyes
shots.narration_am: ከንጹህ ልብ የወጡ ቃላቶች እንደ ዘር በውስጤ ተዘርተው አደገ።
shots.narration_en: Words from a pure heart were sown in me like a seed, and they grew.

shots.reason: An empty landscape carries the time jump and the death without showing a funeral; the sunrise says the blessing outlives him.
shots.keyframe_prompt: wide shot of golden sunrise breaking over misty green Ethiopian highland hills, a small house with a corrugated roof and eucalyptus trees in the foreground, empty wooden chair by the doorway, peaceful dawn
shots.motion_prompt: slow pan across the sunlit highlands, mist drifting
shots.narration_am: ብዙ ዓመታት አለፉ፤ አባቴም ወደ ፈጣሪው ሄደ፣ ግን ምርቃቱ አብሮኝ ቆየ።
shots.narration_en: Many years passed. My father went home to his Creator, but his blessing stayed with me.

shots.reason: Shows the blessing fulfilled: the same girl, now grown, standing in the light he wished for her.
shots.keyframe_prompt: medium shot of the woman standing calmly and confidently in a sunlit courtyard in warm morning light, serene smile
shots.motion_prompt: slow tracking push-in as morning light reaches her face
shots.narration_am: የተመኘልኝ ሰላም፣ ጥበብ እና ክብር በሕይወቴ አንድ በአንድ ተፈጸሙ።
shots.narration_en: The peace, wisdom and honour he wished for me came true in my life, one by one.

shots.reason: The emotional peak: gratitude on her face as she remembers him, mirroring the child's close-up in shot 3.
shots.keyframe_prompt: close-up of the woman with gentle tears of gratitude in her eyes, looking softly upward, warm sunlight touching her face
shots.motion_prompt: slow subtle tilt up with soft light shift
shots.narration_am: በእያንዳንዱ ስኬቴ ውስጥ የአባቴን ንጹህ ልብ አስታውሳለሁ።
shots.narration_en: In every success of mine, I remember my father's pure heart.

shots.reason: A transition to the father's point of view; luminous sky instead of a literal heaven keeps it reverent for every faith.
shots.keyframe_prompt: wide ethereal view of soft luminous clouds and warm golden rays of morning light over the highlands far below, serene reverent atmosphere
shots.motion_prompt: slow forward drift through soft golden light
shots.narration_am: ከሰማይም አባቴ ሕይወቴን ሲያይ፣ ልቡ በደስታ ይሞላል።
shots.narration_en: And when my father looks on my life from heaven, his heart fills with joy.

shots.reason: Closes the circle on the father's face: the joy of the one who gave the blessing.
shots.keyframe_prompt: medium close-up of the father standing outdoors on a highland hilltop at golden hour, radiant warm sun rays and soft luminous clouds behind him, looking down with a joyful, thankful smile, peaceful
shots.motion_prompt: slow gentle hold with soft golden glow
shots.narration_en: Seeing his daughter live by his blessing, he rejoices.
